text:
mira: Quick ask for runtime: can we run a focused bench for the launch narrative? Need a fast smoke + an A/B probe (baseline vs quantized candidate) using our demo 250 set. Target: artifacts for comms in 48h.

dan: sure. what exactly do you want returned? tight list pls.

mira: Deliverables: 1) per-request CSV (latency_ms, req_id, tokens_in, tokens_out, model_tag), 2) aggregated percentiles (p50/p90/p99) and avg tokens, 3) simple cost estimate per 1k requests, 4) warmup-coldstart comparison (image) and 5) the exact runner command + seed link. Also flag any fallback variant used.

rachel: tiny add: include whether KV-caching kicked in, and capture model tag hashes so we can cite exact model. If quantized run is unstable, note the memory/kernel fallback.

mira: seed uploaded: https://redwood.co/samples/launch-2026-250.csv. Use rw-large-v1:2026-03-10 as baseline. Try rw-large-v1-q4_0 for quantized candidate. Runner example: 
```bash
RWD_KEY=redacted curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RWD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-large-v1:2026-03-10","input_file":"launch-2026-250.csv","max_tokens":200,"stream":false}'
```
Please redact keys in the packaged runner_cmd.

tom: pinging runtimebot for scheduling and whether quantized path exists on the staging pool. @runtimebot?

runtimebot: job queued: jb_launch_1798. Est run time 3.0h on staging-gpu-3. Quantized runtime path available on staging with q4 kernels. Note: under high host load fallback to rw-medium may occur; we'll record any fallback events.

dan: success criteria from marketing side: <1% errors, p99 within expected bounds (we expect ~<800ms baseline). If quantized p99 > baseline by >20% flag it and don't use in headline.

mira: agreed. If quantized regresses >20% we keep baseline in the post and surface q-run in an appendix with a note.

runtimebot: job jb_launch_1798 started. Will emit artifacts to /artifacts/jb_launch_1798/ on completion.

runtimebot: job jb_launch_1798 finished (3h12m). Artifacts: latency_report.csv, aggregates.txt, warmup_cold_heatmap.png, runner_cmd_redacted.txt, fallback_log.txt. Quantized p99 = +18% vs baseline. Cache hit rate ~12%. No hard failures.

dan: grabbing artifacts now. i'll redact keys and compute the scaled cost-per-1k estimate.

rachel: good to know about ~12% cache hits. can we get a one-line note on whether the workload benefited from batching heuristics?

runtimebot: note: dynamic batching engaged on staging; mean batch size during run = 4. Will include in README.

mira: thanks team. marketing decision: use baseline numbers in headline, add short footnote "quantized candidate showed 18% higher p99 in staging probe (see appendix)" and include a webinar deep-dive for quantization roadmap. dan, can you produce a 1-slide summary + appendix blurb? ETA 10h?

dan: yes — i'll prepare slide + 2-paragraph appendix.
\rtom: tagging #sre-ops in case packaging needs signoff. closing loop here unless something else pops up. :rocket:
